answer: Attacker cost scales linearly—spawning N sybils requires N bonds, forfeited on collusion detection. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce on-chain resource: each agent must bond tokens locked at a registration vertex, and duplicate identities collapse into one when their bonds share the same provenance chain. Like limestone filtering through karst, fake identities drain out while honest stake settles; the registry acts as a lagoon where only funded, verified agents persist.
